name: cbr-provider
description: CBR's protocol provider. Claims only what it implements: core/1 and the conformance-only core-test/1, over stdio, with no features and no test controls. Run with --repo pointing at vendor/protocol/v0.1.0, which holds the pinned schemas and fixtures; the launch path is relative to that so this descriptor carries no machine-specific path. Build the binary first: cargo build --workspace.
